translationRepairs: When Zheng Zhuang served as Grand Director of Agriculture, he instructed his gatekeepers: 'When guests arrive, whether noble or humble, no one is to be kept waiting at the gate.'
When Zheng Zhuang served as Grand Astrologer, he instructed his gatekeepers: 'When guests arrive, whether noble or humble, no one is to be kept waiting at the gate.'

Focus unit has 莊為太史, not 大農令 from s0136. 太史 is the Grand Astrologer/Scribe office; the idiomatic English wrongly carried over Grand Director of Agriculture. The proposed replacement matches the Chinese and leaves the rest of the sentence intact.
When Zhuang served as Grand Director of Agriculture, he instructed his doorkeepers: 'When guests arrive, whether noble or humble, none are to be kept waiting at the gate.'
When Zhuang served as Grand Astrologer, he instructed his doorkeepers: 'When guests arrive, whether noble or humble, none are to be kept waiting at the gate.'

The same focus Chinese 莊為太史 is misrendered in the literal as Grand Director of Agriculture. Replacing that title with Grand Astrologer corrects the office name without altering the gatekeeping instruction.
